newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes at day's high in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes at day's high in Hong Kong.

text.p: Gold closed at the day's high on Thursday on mild short-covering but remained trapped within a range of 30 U.S. cents in an extremely quiet session following its sharp rally in New York, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$343.60/344.10 an ounce against New York's US$342.80/343.30 close on Wednesday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$337.50/338.00.
"The market is very nervous and there is no news to support gold," a senior dealer at a local investment house said.
"Players are unsure of where the market is turning next and most dealers are watching U.S. dollar and others metals movements," another dealer said.
Local gold ended HK$52 higher at HK$3,178 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +8.00 from its previous fix at +5.00.
